purpose: Supplementary SOL364 implementation and evidence questions; historical contact query sets remain unchanged. Retrieval success does not imply physical acceptance.

questions.query: Why can the old contact midpoint leave a Sand cell while a valid exterior witness remains, and what does SOL364 repair?
facts: The planner transports and reclips only the original authenticated exterior segment at the present pose.
Current clipped midpoint and length determine force weighting and torque; the repair never extends to unobserved face area or fills a hole.
All original records and duplicates are validated before cleared segments are filtered; source/current pose and identity fences remain.

questions.query: Does accepting a fresh stationary Sand contact or repairing its witness guarantee sustained clearance of a buried aggregate?
facts: Interior overlap can exist without an exterior-face witness.
An accepted stationary contact can produce no impulse because the dissipative velocity constraint supplies no positional recovery work.
Sustained clearance remains a separate failed or unpassed gate; draft PR347 and blocked restoration365 are not promoted by execution success.

questions.query: When can detached-body overlap be reported as cell-ticks, and how do synchronized contact controls differ from asynchronous sessions?
facts: Only a complete every-declared-step exact-geometry trace supports cell-ticks; deliberately missed response delivery does not omit geometry measurement.
The synchronized fixture freezes the native field, disables body sleeping in all arms and compares the retained planner with the repair on identical frozen observations.
Ordinary asynchronous native and conservative-displacement trials retain cell-sample/area-sample metrics and are not matched causal trajectories.

questions.query: How does native contact freezing reduce work without hiding refused or overwritten attempts or changing the original full-matrix cost gate?
facts: Native scalar contact/proxy records are sealed at construction; the worker seals metadata and preserves a recursive fallback for markerless runtimes.
All owner and main response attempt work remains in the numerator and complete consumed observations remain the denominator.
All 24 original baseline/candidate host groups retain the 2 ms limit; incomplete cohorts and candidate-only success cannot establish the complete gate.
